OpenVibe.Wiki is part of OpenVibe, an open source, community-run network. Use it for lawful things, be decent to other people, and do not try to break it. We can remove content or accounts that break these terms. The software is provided as it is, without warranties.

Who can use it

You must be at least 13 years old, or the minimum age of digital consent where you live. If you are under 18, a parent or guardian must agree to these terms for you. You may not use OpenVibe.Wiki if you were previously banned from the network.

Most of OpenVibe.Wiki works without signing in. An OpenVibe account, managed at openvibe.network, adds things that need to remember you. You are responsible for what happens under your account; keep your password to yourself and tell us if you think someone else has it.

Rules

OpenVibe leans toward open expression. These limits apply everywhere:

  • Nothing illegal where you are or where our servers are (United States).
  • No sexual content involving minors, and no sexualisation of minors, ever.
  • No credible threats of violence, and no publishing of someone's private information to harm them.
  • No content you do not have the rights to.
  • No malware, phishing, spam, scraping that ignores robots.txt rate limits, or attempts to disrupt or gain unauthorised access to the service or to other people's systems.

We may remove content, limit features, or suspend accounts that break these terms or put other people or the service at risk. You can stop using OpenVibe.Wiki at any time and delete your account from your account settings.
